title: The delivery-attempt log records one row per surfaced notification, in the shape owned by TAC-2102, for later inspection
asA: operator inspecting the notification behaviour of a shipped rcf-lite application
iWant: one row in the delivery-attempt log per notification the shell surfaced, in the shape owned by `TAC-2102.interfaces.deliveryRowShape`
soThat: I can reconcile what the shell said with what my operators saw and acknowledged

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a shipped surface that has surfaced N notifications, `GET /api/delivery-log` returns HTTP 200 with body `{ rows: [...] }` and `rows.length === N`; each row honours the shape owned by `TAC-2102.interfaces.deliveryRowShape`. Rows are append-only; the same delivery event never appears twice on the same page load. The pack does not itself enumerate every row (the delivery-log persistence is delegated to the applied `logging` companion); the AC is a mechanism-reach gap for a v1.1 minor bump when the pack gains a log-shape probe.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a shipped surface after N notifications
acceptanceCriteria.then: N rows with the operator-readable fields are returned

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the delivery-log write factory (TAC-2102 `writeDeliveryRow`), a call from the toast factory and a call from the centre factory both write through the applied `logging` companion's record factory (the row shape lives on this blueprint; the persistence layer lives on the companion). A row written outside the companion's factory bypasses the companion's retention and audit path and is refused at project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.when: a toast or centre event surfaces a notification
acceptanceCriteria.then: a row lands through the applied logging companion

acceptanceCriteria.description: A delivery-attempt log row honours exactly the field set owned by `TAC-2102.interfaces.deliveryRowShape`; a row missing any owner-required field refuses the write with DELIVERY_ROW_INCOMPLETE naming the missing owner-required field (per the owner shape).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a delivery attempt whose row is missing an owner-required field owned by `TAC-2102.interfaces.deliveryRowShape`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the write refuses with DELIVERY_ROW_INCOMPLETE naming the missing owner-required field and no partial row is persisted

acceptanceCriteria.description: When no applied blueprint provides the `logging` companion (no writeDeliveryRow factory on the applied set), apply refuses with LOGGING_COMPANION_MISSING naming the required remedy (apply the logging companion so the delivery-log rows can persist); no delivery-log entries are written and the toast and centre factories refuse to construct.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project applying application-notifications-in-app with no logging companion applied
acceptanceCriteria.then: apply exits with a non-zero code and LOGGING_COMPANION_MISSING is emitted naming the remedy (apply the logging companion)
